name: UI：生图节点-边界值验证(空Prompt/空模型类型/必填校验)
description: 验证生图节点的必填校验：模型类型为空时保存报错、User Prompt为空时保存报错、不添加输入图片时可保存(非必填)、输出模式默认选中

steps.description: 新建策略用于边界测试

steps.expression: return (() => { const input = document.querySelector('input#name'); if (!input) return { ok: false }; const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; const ts = Date.now().toString(36); setter.call(input, 'auto-img-val-' + ts); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles:true})); return { ok: true, name: 'auto-img-val-' + ts }; })()

return (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#stageCode'); if (!el) return false; const sel = el.closest('.ant-select'); const target = sel?.querySelector('.ant-select-selector') || sel; if (target) { target.setAttribute('data-testid', 'stage-select'); return true; } return false; })()

return (() => { const dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-dropdown:not(.ant-select-dropdown-hidden)'); for (const dd of dropdowns) { const options = Array.from(dd.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-item-option')); const target = options.find(o => (o.querySelector('.ant-select-item-option-content')?.textContent || '').trim() === '视觉'); if (target) { target.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', {bubbles:true,cancelable:true,view:window})); target.click(); return {ok:true, selected:'视觉'}; } } return {ok:false}; })()

return (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#lifeCycleCode'); if (!el) return false; const sel = el.closest('.ant-select'); const target = sel?.querySelector('.ant-select-selector') || sel; if (target) { target.setAttribute('data-testid', 'lifecycle-select'); return true; } return false; })()

return (() => { const dropdowns = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-dropdown:not(.ant-select-dropdown-hidden)'); for (const dd of dropdowns) { const options = Array.from(dd.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-item-option')); const target = options.find(o => (o.querySelector('.ant-select-item-option-content')?.textContent || '').trim() === '实验'); if (target) { target.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', {bubbles:true,cancelable:true,view:window})); target.click(); return {ok:true, selected:'实验'}; } } return {ok:false}; })()

return (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { ok: false }; const btn = [...modal.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => /确.*定/.test(b.textContent.replace(/\s/g,''))); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { ok: true }; } return { ok: false }; })()

return (() => { const modals = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-modal'); for (const m of modals) { if (m.classList.contains('ant-modal-hidden')) continue; const cards = m.querySelectorAll('.ant-card'); for (const card of cards) { const t = card.querySelector('.ant-card-meta-title'); if (t && t.textContent.trim() === '生图') { card.click(); return {ok:true}; } } } return {ok:false}; })()

steps.description: 等待生图节点抽屉加载

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return { open: false }; const modelSelect = drawer.querySelector('.ant-select'); const promptTextarea = drawer.querySelector('textarea'); return { open: true, modelSelectExists: !!modelSelect, promptTextareaExists: !!promptTextarea, modelSelectValue: modelSelect ? (modelSelect.querySelector('.ant-select-selection-item')?.textContent?.trim() || '') : null, promptValue: promptTextarea ? (promptTextarea.value || '') : null }; })()
steps.description: 检查模型类型和Prompt初始状态(应为空)
不填写任何内容直接保存(触发必填校验)

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const errors = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-form-item-explain-error, .ant-form-item-explain, .ant-form-item-has-error .ant-form-item-explain')); const errorTexts = errors.map(e => (e.textContent || '').trim()).filter(t => t.length > 0); const hasError = document.querySelector('.ant-message-error, .ant-message .ant-message-error'); return { errorCount: errorTexts.length, errorTexts: errorTexts.slice(0, 10), hasGlobalError: !!hasError }; })()

steps.description: 空表单保存时至少1个必填校验报错(模型类型/User Prompt)

steps.expression: return (() => { const drawer = document.querySelector('.ant-drawer:not(.ant-drawer-hidden)'); if (!drawer) return {}; const radios = Array.from(drawer.querySelectorAll('.ant-radio-wrapper')); const checkedRadio = radios.find(r => r.querySelector('input[type=radio]:checked')); const radioLabels = radios.map(r => { const label = (r.textContent || '').trim(); const checked = !!r.querySelector('input[type=radio]:checked'); return { label, checked }; }); return { outputModeRadios: radioLabels, defaultChecked: checkedRadio ? (checkedRadio.textContent || '').trim() : null }; })()
